routine-cheveux-naturels.title: How to care for kinky hair in Dakar
routine-cheveux-naturels.intro: The basics of a simple, effective routine for coily and curly hair, adapted to Dakar's dry, dusty climate.
routine-cheveux-naturels.metaDescription: Caring for kinky hair in Dakar: gentle washing, hydration, sealing and protective styles. HairSpa Dakar's tips for strong, shiny natural hair.
paragraphs: Start by observing your hair: porosity, density and dryness level determine the right products. An in-salon diagnosis helps set realistic growth and volume goals.
Wash gently: a mild shampoo followed by a hydrating deep treatment, once or twice a week, is enough in most cases. Detangling is always done on damp hair saturated with conditioner.
Seal in moisture with an oil or leave-in cream, focusing on the ends. At night, a satin bonnet or scarf limits breakage and frizz.
Finally, space out manipulation: the less your hair is handled, the less it breaks. Protective styles are your best allies between treatments.

coiffures-protectrices.title: Choosing a protective style for your texture
coiffures-protectrices.intro: Braids, twists, buns: how to choose and install protection suited to your texture, without breakage.
coiffures-protectrices.metaDescription: Braids, twists, buns: pick the right protective style for your hair texture. Tension-free installation and care by HairSpa Dakar.
paragraphs: A protective style limits daily manipulation and preserves the ends. But it must be installed without excessive tension: a braid pulling at the hairline or temples will cause breakage.
Prepare your hair before installation: shampoo, deep treatment and careful detangling. Clean, moisturized hair gets far more benefit from the protection.
Do not tighten extensions and let your scalp breathe: a light massage with growth oils once a week keeps circulation going without undoing the style.
Keep the style for six to eight weeks maximum, then give your hair a moisturizing break before the next installation.

entretenir-soin-vapeur.title: The benefits of steam treatment for natural hair
entretenir-soin-vapeur.intro: Why steam treatment is natural hair's best ally in Dakar, and the habits that keep hydration going between appointments.
entretenir-soin-vapeur.metaDescription: Steam treatment opens the cuticles and deeply hydrates natural hair. Discover its benefits and how to extend them at home, in Dakar.
paragraphs: Steam opens the cuticles and lets the treatment penetrate deeply: it is the most effective step of your hair routine. But its benefits are also maintained at home.
In the following days, keep moisture up with a light leave-in, plus a hydrating spray if your ends feel dry. Avoid unprotected direct heat.
Sleep on satin and tie your hair in a pineapple or loose braids to reduce night friction.
Book your next ritual every four to six weeks: consistency matters more than the intensity of a single treatment.
